diagnostic_broad_proxy.label: Canada motor vehicles and parts exports to the U.S. / 2024 nominal GDP
diagnostic_broad_proxy.use: Diagnostic only. This broad category is not the proclamation's Annex II scope and must not be interpreted as event PolicyImpact or as an MXN/CAD return forecast.

mxn_cad_case.message: Mexico is not directly targeted by this Canada-specific event, but no relative tradable alpha is published until the 439 Annex II tariff lines are valued and a historical FX/rates transmission model is estimated.

next_gate: Value the 439 Annex II HTSUS tariff lines using point-in-time Canada-to-U.S. trade data, divide by contemporaneously available GDP, then estimate historical FX and 2Y transmission before producing a residual-alpha signal.
